signals.title: OPERA OPEN 2026: Jesus Christ Superstar
signals.reason: An open-air rock opera in the Roman amphitheater, though the late start and sound volume are better suited for adults than a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for August 22, 2026 at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: TheatAir 2026 (13th International Street Arts Festival)
signals.reason: A vibrant outdoor street festival packed with puppetry, circus acts, and interactive family performances across city spaces.

signals.title: Kose Bose (Косе Босе) Puppet Show
signals.reason: A classic fairytale puppet show specifically staged for young children at Plovdiv's dedicated puppet theatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on the State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv website for September 12, 2026.

signals.title: Festival #BeActive Asenovgrad
signals.reason: A short 25-minute drive away, offering free sports, outdoor movement sessions, and fun physical activities suitable for kids.
signals.note: Confirmed on asenovgrad.bg and plovdivnow.bg for September 1–6, 2026 in Asenovgrad.

signals.title: Island Park Svoboda (Остров Свобода)
signals.reason: A top family favorite featuring extensive play grounds, shaded walking trails, and small animals on a river island.

signals.title: Stara Zagora Zoo
signals.reason: A spacious, newly renovated zoo located inside a pine forest park, offering gentle walking paths and animal viewing.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: A short 15-minute drive from Plovdiv featuring impressive outdoor fighters and helicopters with open grassy areas for toddlers.

signals.title: Stand-up Comedy in English: Elena Gabrielle – "Disturb the Vibe"
signals.location: The Comedy Club Plovdiv, 15 Gladstone St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Touring English-language stand-up comedian performing right in central Plovdiv; fully legible and matches high-priority taste profile.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventbrite.com and elenagabrielle.com for September 23, 2026 at Comedy Club Plovdiv.

signals.title: Rock Opera: "Jesus Christ Superstar" at Opera Open 2026
signals.location: Ancient Theatre of Plovdiv (Античен театър), Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: State Opera Plovdiv production of Andrew Lloyd Webber's classic rock opera under the stars in the Roman amphitheatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for August 22, 2026 at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: Concert: "A Night at the Opera with the Music of Queen"
signals.location: Ancient Theatre of Plovdiv, Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Symphonic and vocal rock tribute performance honoring Queen as part of Opera Open 2026; non-verbal / English rock music.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and operabase.com for August 24, 2026 at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: Live Outdoor Concert: Italian Singer Al Bano
signals.location: Ancient Theatre of Plovdiv, Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Legendary Italian pop artist live performance at the open-air Ancient Theatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on stubhub.com and eventim.bg for August 30, 2026 at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: Slow. Art. Consumption. Festival of Analog Art
signals.location: Elysium Cultural Center, 2 Dusho Hadzhidekov St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Multi-genre festival dedicated to analog visual art, contemplative experience, and exhibitions in central Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com for September 4–26, 2026 at Elysium Cultural Center.

signals.title: Daily Direct Flights from Plovdiv Airport to London Luton
signals.reason: Direct flight frequency between Plovdiv and London Luton expands from 3 weekly to 7 days a week, significantly easing international travel logistics.
signals.note: Refuted by Wizz Air in marica.bg on July 27, 2026; daily flight expansion was denied and frequency is 5 times weekly instead.

signals.title: New Commercial Retail Park: EastRoad Retail Park
signals.location: Eastern Ring Road (near Skobeleva Maika cloverleaf & Skutare turnoff), Plovdiv
signals.reason: New retail zone on the eastern bypass featuring international home and lifestyle stores as well as specialized food markets.
signals.note: Confirmed on citybuild.bg regarding the opening of EastRoad Retail Park on the eastern ring road of Plovdiv.

signals.title: Major Central Street Closure on Dr. G. M. Dimitrov Street
signals.location: Ul. Dr. G. M. Dimitrov (between Tsar Asen I St and Avksentiy Veleshki St), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Complete closure to vehicular traffic for major road and sidewalk reconstruction right by the central pedestrian area.
signals.note: Confirmed on 24chasa.bg for road reconstruction and closure until September 13, 2026.

signals.title: Football Match Traffic Disruption: Lokomotiv Plovdiv vs. Arda Kardzhali
signals.reason: First Professional Football League match causing localized crowds, road diversions, and congestion in and around Lauta Park.
signals.note: Confirmed on forebet.com and oddspedia.com for August 23, 2026 at Lokomotiv Stadium.
